extracted.intended_audience: beginner learners of Japanese (travelers, casual/self-study users)
extracted.subtask_description: A 48-lesson beginner course for learning basic Japanese conversation, travel phrases, greetings, and cultural tips using audio, animated video, and text. Includes self-study features (quizzes, progress tracking) and downloadable resources for personal use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall learning goal: basics of Japanese conversation
rubrics_metrics.description: The site helps you learn the basics of Japanese conversation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The lessons aim to teach foundational conversational skills appropriate for beginners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific objective: master daily greetings and travel phrases
rubrics_metrics.description: Master daily greetings and travel phrases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on practical language needed for everyday interactions and travel situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include sightseeing hints and cultural tips
rubrics_metrics.description: The lessons also include sightseeing hints and cultural tips.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultural/contextual information is provided alongside language items to aid real-world use and understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimodal instruction: audio, animated video, and text
rubrics_metrics.description: The website--with audio, animated video, and text--helps you learn the basics of Japanese.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use all available modalities (listen, watch, read) to reinforce learning; materials are provided in multiple formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: 48 lessons
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The curriculum is organized into a 48-lesson sequence covering the basics; choose lessons or follow sequentially.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to use site features: track progress and review quizzes
rubrics_metrics.description: Track your progress on your personalized My Haru-san page. Review your quizzes too, and register words and phrases you’d like to remember.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learners are encouraged to register, use the My Haru-san page for progress tracking, review quiz results regularly, and save vocabulary for spaced repetition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalized account: My Haru-san page
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep track of your progress on your personalized My Haru-san page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creating an account enables progress tracking and access to saved words/quiz history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment: quizzes available for review
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quizzes are provided as an assessment and review tool; learners should use them to gauge retention and practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Downloadable resources for personal use only
rubrics_metrics.description: MP3 audio files of the lessons and PDF files of the textbook can be downloaded free of charge (for personal use only).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Materials may be downloaded but are restricted to personal use; redistribution or commercial use is not permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learner support: supervisors answer questions
rubrics_metrics.description: Program supervisors Fujinaga Kaoru and Isomura Kazuhiro respond to listeners' inquiries about the Japanese language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learners can submit questions to receive supervisor responses, providing expert clarification and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content organization: sections and lesson components
rubrics_metrics.description: Site navigation includes sections such as Japanese Letters, Skits, Key Phrases, Exercises, Vocabulary, Culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lessons are organized into thematic/functional components (letters, skits, key phrases, exercises, vocabulary, cultural notes) to structure learning and practice.
